title: Quintessential α-attractors, updated
summary: Quintessential $α$-attractor models of single-field inflation and evolving dark energy were constructed about a decade ago. Recently, it was pointed out that some of them might be disfavored due to dark-radiation constraints on gravitational waves and the higher values of $n_s$ favored by ACT. Here we present a class of updated quintessential $α$-attractor models in which a single field describes both inflation and evolving dark energy, yields higher values of $n_s$, and admits reheating scenarios consistent with the dark-radiation bound on $ΔN_{\rm eff}$.
